title: NHK Special — 超高齢社会の日本 (Japan's Super-Aged Society)
description: NHK Special documentary on Japan's super-aged society (超高齢社会) — the first country in the world where over 28% of the population is aged 65 or older. Examines rural depopulation, the shortage of care workers, robot-assisted nursing care, and the concept of 'community care' that aims to help elderly people stay in their homes.
creator: NHK Special (NHKスペシャル)
